cryReasons.title: Why is she crying?

redFlags.label: When to call for help
redFlags.title: Call your pediatrician or emergency services if she has:
redFlags.fever: A fever. Babies under 3 months with a fever need a call right away.
redFlags.unusualSleepiness: Unusual sleepiness, or is hard to wake
redFlags.bulgingOrStiffFontanelle: A bulging or stiff soft spot on the head

facts.sinceLastFeedUsual: Last fed {{since}} ago; she usually goes about {{usual}}.
facts.sinceLastFeedSmaller: Last fed {{since}} ago; that feed was smaller than usual, so she may want more sooner.
facts.feedingNow: A feed is running, started {{since}} ago.
facts.awakeForUsual: Awake for {{since}}; she usually stays up about {{usual}}.
facts.sinceLastDiaperUsual: Last diaper {{since}} ago; she usually goes about {{usual}}.
facts.dirtyDueAfterFeed: A dirty diaper often comes about now after a feed.
facts.dirtyDueGap: A dirty diaper may come around {{time}}.
facts.recentFeedNoBurp: Fed {{since}} ago, with no burp logged since.
facts.reliefAfterFeed: Fed {{since}} ago, and a burp or massage was logged.
facts.bellyPattern: Belly pain often shows up around {{time}}.
facts.eveningFussy: Evenings are a common fussy time at this age.
facts.asleep: A sleep timer is still running, so the log may be behind.

try.sleepy: Try dimming the room and starting to wind down.
try.gas: Try holding her upright, burping her or a gentle belly massage.
try.comfort: Try holding her skin to skin, a snug swaddle or gentle rocking, with soft white noise.

worked.title: What worked?
worked.hint: Optional. Choosing one logs this crying spell.

cryReasons.footer: This list only uses what you have logged. It is not a diagnosis or medical advice, and Lotties is not a medical device.
